responsibility: Render one production memory as a Focus surface with single-column content, persisted MemoryUserEdit/conflict state, capability-gated source actions, on-demand translation and grounded citation navigation. Original-source deletion is offered only for writable resolvable PhotoKit photo/video.

inputs.memory: MemoryDetailModel mapped from CanonicalMemory + MemoryUserEdit + MemoryEditConflict. Original source content remains separate from user title/multiline description/normalized tags.
inputs.sourceDeletionCapability: removeFromEchoOnly | photoLibraryDeletable; note/voice/thirdParty Share Extension sources never claim source-app deletion authority

outputs.visibleContent: Original source content plus user edit overlay, translated text, grouped metadata, verified citation anchors and capability-gated actions. Production media is resolved under current UserPolicy; unresolved/revoked/missing media shows an honest localized fallback. Bundled samples are Preview/test-only.
outputs.interactionTargets: translateToggle, editButton, deleteButton, conflictActionButtons, saveButton, citationAnchor, retryButton, mediaPlayPause
outputs.accessibilityTree: Content in reading order; grouped metadata; media preview with label; each citation anchor as separate element

systemContainer: NavigationStack (pushed from Search/Home) + ScrollView + Form sheet for edit + Alert for delete confirmation
